measurement.rss: process.memoryUsage().rss; per process, never exclusive application footprint
measurement.privateMemory: process.getProcessMemoryInfo().private, KiB converted to bytes; pre-compression private memory, not physical footprint
measurement.privateBytes: Electron ProcessMetric privateBytes, Windows only; null on macOS
measurement.footprint: N/A unless independently measured with Instruments/VM Tracker
measurement.gpu: GPU process working set only; IOSurface allocation N/A
measurement.cold: Fresh application/profile/SQLite connection; OS filesystem cache is not flushed
measurement.cpu: CPU microseconds and Electron interval averages, reported separately from latency
measurement.frames: RAF intervals during short instrumented actions; nearest-rank P50/P95/P99. Not compositor or display FPS.
measurement.feedback: Trusted input to first changed target DOM/style observed on RAF; a paint-opportunity proxy, not physical presentation latency.
measurement.pointerInput: Menu/drawer clicks use focused BrowserWindow webContents.sendInputEvent at rounded CSS center × native content width / CSS viewport width. Record getZoomFactor() as reportedZoom; trusted pointerdown target and CSS coordinates verified within 1px. Divider drag uses Playwright page.mouse at zoom=1.
measurement.storage: Storage.setItem calls for roc.ui.*; duringDrag counts workspace.layout writes between trusted pointerdown and pointerup/cancel/Escape.

limitations: Each round starts a fresh Electron process and cloned isolated profile. Ordinary prebuilt dist only; no profiling build, OS cache flush, or external service.
CDP trace and RAF/style observers add overhead. Trace long tasks are not automatically attributable to animations. Heap/DOM/process memory are point samples.
Physical display frequency is reported only when Electron exposes it. Zoom=2 creates a 720×450 CSS viewport inside the same native 1440×900 content area.
One aggregate sample per scenario per independent round. With five rounds the nearest-rank P95 is the maximum. Individual input/RAF events are not independent rounds.

No raw trace, screenshots, video, provider request bodies, secrets or disposable child reports retained. Human perception, touchpad, IME, VoiceOver, another Mac and low-power comparisons require separate acceptance.

electronZoomPointerCoordinates.scaledCdpInput: Repeated Playwright/CDP clicks remained unstable; coordinate multiplication alone was not a verified resolution.
electronZoomPointerCoordinates.resolution: Hit-test CSS centers; focus BrowserWindow, measure native content width / CSS viewport width, and send rounded native mouseMove/left mouseDown/mouseUp with webContents.sendInputEvent. Record reportedZoom, effectiveScale and nativeContentSize; verify trusted pointerdown target and CSS point.
